verdict.rationale: Fireworks' pricing page says users can set a monthly spend limit to cap usage, which directly addresses keeping a runaway workload from producing an unbounded bill. The evidence is a single first-party sentence with no further detail. Missing for 10: detail on how the cap is enforced (whether it hard-stops requests or on-demand deployments), budget or threshold alert notifications, per-project or per-key granularity, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the limit works.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps or budget alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill

citations.quote: set a monthly spend limit to cap usage
